title: Musher Validation Result
description: What one validation of one document reports: its status, the validation scope it reaches, the phase it reached, its diagnostics and its deferred obligations. Core v2 §6.1 and §7 are normative; this schema states their shape.
$comment: Not a document schema: no author writes one, and it rejects no Musher document. Every object is closed. ExpectedDiagnostic is the subset a conformance fixture declares (docs/conformance.md).

status.description: INVALID when an ERROR diagnostic is reported; otherwise INCOMPLETE when an obligation was deferred; otherwise VALID. No caller reads INCOMPLETE as approval.

phase.description: For INVALID, the phase that rejected the document. For INCOMPLETE, the last phase entered. For VALID, the last phase of the validation scope.

diagnostics.description: Every condition reported, ERROR and WARNING alike, in no normative order.

deferred.description: The obligations of the validation scope that could not be decided with the context supplied.

ValidationPhase.description: A validation phase, in order (core v2 §6).

ValidationScope.description: How far a validation result reaches, on the lattice of core v2 §6.1, smallest first.

ResolutionStage.description: A stage of the resolution phase, in order (core v2 §6.4).

Severity.description: ERROR is a failure of the document and makes a result INVALID. WARNING is advisory: it never changes a result's status, and no consumer reads it as approval (core v2 §7).

DiagnosticCode.description: A code from the diagnostic registry of the document's family: ERR_ for a code its diagnostics tables declare, WARN_ for one its Warnings tables declare (core v2 §7).

DocumentPointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into a document. The empty string is its root.

RelatedLocation.description: A location in another document a cross-document diagnostic also concerns.

artifact.description: The other document, by the reference that names it, such as a componentRef. It never carries a sensitive value.

Diagnostic.description: One reported condition (core v2 §7). code, severity, phase, path and a resolution diagnostic's stage are normative; message is not.

path.description: The primary location: a pointer into the submitted document, or into artifact when that is present.

stage.description: The resolution stage that found the condition. Present exactly when phase is resolution, and never null.

artifact.description: Present when the primary location is in another document of the same item, which it names by its item-relative path. Absent means the submitted document.

message.description: Human-readable text. Not normative, and never a sensitive value.

DeferredObligation.description: A rule the validation scope requires that could not be decided with the context supplied (core v2 §6.1).

rule.description: The requirement ID of the rule left undecided.

path.description: Where in the submitted document the rule applies.

missing.description: The context that is missing. Free text in v2; core v2 §6.1 recommends <context>:<key>.

ExpectedDiagnostic.description: A diagnostic a conformance fixture expects (docs/conformance.md). It matches a produced diagnostic of the same severity, ERROR when severity is absent, on every member it carries. A diagnostics.json entry also carries path.
